summary: Up to three concentric goal rings with glowing heads; progress past the goal laps the ring in a brighter tint and throws sparks.

attributes.name: rings
attributes.description: Comma-separated `Name:current/goal` entries; only the first three are used. Empty entries are skipped, a missing or negative amount counts as 0 and a missing goal as 1. Observed: changes rebuild the legend and animate the rings.

properties.name: items
properties.type: Array<{ name: string, cur: number, goal: number }>

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` giving each ring as a percentage of its goal, for example `Messages 72%, Tokens 46%, Agents 130%`.
The legend shows each current value and goal as text.
Isolating a ring works by pointer hover only; legend rows are not focusable.
motion: With reduced motion the rings show their final progress without the staggered fill and no sparks are drawn; the hover dimming still fades.
notes: Rings use the accent, ok and warn colours from the outside in.
Progress is drawn up to twice the goal; the second lap uses a brighter tint.
The canvas is fixed at 172 × 172 px.

data.note: Pass up to three `Name:current/goal` rings as `rings`. Without it the rings show invented usage figures.
